starting_prompt: Run a shopping simulation at the Downtown Market with the seasonal produce endcap scenario.
conversation_plan: After the simulation completes, ask for a detailed breakdown of endcap conversion rates. Then ask which persona was most influenced by the endcap displays and why. Finally, ask for recommendations on optimizing the endcap placement.

starting_prompt: Compare the baseline scenario vs the snack impulse buy scenario at the Westside Market.
conversation_plan: Ask the agent to run both scenarios and compare total revenue. Then ask about the incremental revenue from endcap placements. Finally, request a recommendation for which scenario management should adopt.

starting_prompt: Simulate 5 shoppers at the Lakefront Market with the health and wellness endcap scenario.
conversation_plan: After simulation, ask which products from the endcap had the highest pickup rate. Then ask whether the health-conscious shopper persona behaved differently from the budget-conscious family. Request a final ROI analysis.
